question: Which crop is grown during the Zaid season in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Cucumber.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• ** Zaid season is the summer cropping season in India, which starts in March and lasts till June.**

 
 
• During this season**, crops that require less water **and have a shorter growth duration are grown.
 
• Cucumber is a popular crop grown during the Zaid season as it has a short growth duration of** 50-60 days and requires less water.**
 
 
 
• **Jowar, Bajra, and Maize are Kharif crops** that are grown during the monsoon season, which starts in June and lasts till September.
 
• **Jowar, also known as sorghum**, is a staple crop in many parts of India and is used to **make roti, porridge, and other dishes.**
 
• **Bajra, also known as pearl millet**, is a nutritious crop that is used to make **roti, porridge, and other dishes.**
 
• ** Maize**,** also known as corn, is a versatile crop that is used to make popcorn, tortillas, and other dishes.**
